decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used for a caf? and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class A3 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for caf? (A3) purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times:07.00 - 18.30 Monday - Saturday and10.00 - 16.00 Sunday, Public and Bank Holidays

Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 6 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.
Condition : 7 - The scheme approved under Condition 6 shall be fully implemented before the A3 caf? use opens to customers.

Condition : 8 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 9 - The scheme of ventilation approved under Condition 8 shall be fully implemented before the use is commenced.

Condition : 10 - The kitchen extract system should comprise a three-stage system to include a grease, pre-and carbon filter where:?	The duct should terminate one metre above eaves level, or one metre above any openable windows of adjacent premises whichever is the higher; ?	The duct should terminate pointing upwards;?	A cowl should be omitted and lightweight flaps or other covers, which open when the system is powered, should be fitted; and?	The system should be routinely serviced.

Condition : 11 - The kitchen extraction system installed should not cause an increase in background noise level (BNL) in the vicinity. When the system is operating at maximum, the noise level should be 10dB(A) lower than the BNL.
Condition : 12 - The ceiling/floor separation should comply with the minimum construction/insulation standards set out in the building regulations.

Condition : 13 - 1.	The proposed change of use of the ground floor premises at 114 Chiswick High Road from retail (A1) to caf? (A3) would not unduly harm the amenity of the streetscene or appearance of the original building and is therefore consistent with Policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and S.1.4 (Non-Retail Uses in Locations Outside Primary and Secondary Frontages Within the Main Shopping Areas) of the Unitary Development Plan.
2.	The proposed change of use of the ground floor premises at 114 Chiswick High Road from retail (A1) to caf? (A3) would not, either individually or cumulatively, unduly harm the residential amenity of neighbouring properties, including from storage of waste, odours, noise and disruption or from disruption to on-street parking and is therefore consistent with Policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), S.1.4 (Non-Retail Uses in Locations Outside Primary and Secondary Frontages Within the Main Shopping Areas) and T.1.2 (The Movement Implications of Development).
3.	The proposed change of use of the ground floor premises at 114 Chiswick High Road from retail (A1) to caf? (A3) would not adversely affect the remaining retail function of the parade between 102 and 120 Chiswick High Road and the wider parades of Chiswick High Road and is therefore consistent with Policy S.1.4 (Non-Retail Uses in Locations Outside Primary and Secondary Frontages Within the Main Shopping Areas).
4.	The proposed change of use of the ground floor premises at 114 Chiswick High Road from retail (A1) to caf? (A3) would provide satisfactory provision to and within the proposed use for people with disabilities and others with mobility problems including shoppers with pushchairs, thereby according with Policy S.1.4 (Non-Retail Uses in Locations Outside Primary and Secondary Frontages Within the Main Shopping Areas).
description: Change of use of ground floor from shop (A1) to  Cafe (A3) with hours of operation 07.00 - 18.30 Monday to Saturday & 10.00 - 16.00 Sunday, Public & Bank Holidays
